sentences.text:
This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.413/2021 registered at Police Station Suthaliya, Distt. Rajgarh (M.P.)
under Sections 366, 376(2)N, 376-D, 342, 344, 506, 34 of IPC.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that the accused persons against whom allegation of rape was made have been granted bail by this court.
He has referred to the order dated 5.4.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.16786/2022.
Initially a report regarding missing of the prosedcutrix was lodged on 12.4.2021.
She was recovered on 28.4.2021.
Her statement was recorded on the said date where she made a statement that she had gone along with Radheshyam willingly and stayed in Rajasthan and other places.
Thereafter, on 21.09.2021, she made a complaint in which she has made allegations against the co-accused persons and accused Radheshyam for committing rape with her.

The fact of recovery of the prosecutrix and recording of her statement has been admitted by father of the Dariyavsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173144715/
1 prosecutrix - Fulsingh.

sentences.text: Further, taking into consideration the statement of the prosecutrix recorded on 28.4.2021 she did not make any allegation of rape against Radheshyam and the present applicant, however, after 5 months she made allegations against other co-accused persons for committing rape with her.
The allegation against the present applicant is only that he had provided shelter to the accused persons and prosecutrix.
Charge sheet has been filed and custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required.
Counsel for State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.
In view of the aforesaid, I find prima facie case is made out for grant of bail to the applicant.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that Applicant shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.

The prison authorities are also requested to ensure compliance with the order passed by the Supreme Court IN RE : CONTAGION OF COVID 19 VIRUS IN PRISONS in SUO MOTU "W.P. (C) No.1/2020" and ensure that the applicant is examined by the jail doctor before release.

If the applicant shows symptoms of COVID-19, the doctor shall forthwith direct applicant to be produced before the appropriate hospital designated for the detection and treatment of COVID-19 patients.

If the doctor is of the opinion that the applicant is not affected with the virus,
the jail authorities shall ensure transportation from the jail till the place of residence.

It is further made clear that if it is found that the applicant is involved in any other case during the trial, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without reference to the Court and the Police will be at liberty to arrest the applicant.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE VM Dariyavsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173144715/
